draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Just checking in as you settle into Wrenfield. The simplest first step is creating one real project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you set up that first project together — just reply with a time that works.

Best,
Nadia
